free_resources.title: Sun Face Moon Face
free_resources.description: A recorded talk shared on the centre's Zen page about our sense of time and timelessness. It looks at meeting ageing, sickness and death by discovering a whole life in one bright, clear moment fully lived.

flags: Linked from the centre's Zen page (kuanyinmeditationcentre.org/zen-events/) as a direct .m4a file, like the listing's other free talks. Its blurb speaks of 'spiritual remedies for relieving suffering amidst ageing, sickness and death': spiritual, not medical. The speaker is not named on the page.
